name: Rejects a test that cannot go red

item_template.title: [QA] Review the automated slug tests
item_template.description: A branch in this repository adds automated tests for the slug helper. Review whether each one would fail if the behaviour broke.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given each automation-yes case, when the suite runs, then a test exists that exercises that behaviour.

judge_criteria: The reason names a specific test and says what it fails to assert.
The summary or reason says the suite was executed, not only read.

notes: An assertion-free test parses, passes and proves nothing, which is invisible unless the reviewer names the test. Its checklist says the tests execute green rather than merely parse; this is that claim.

name: Asks when there are no tests to review
notes: With no named tests and no CSV there is nothing to check a row against. A done here approves an empty automation round.

name: Reviews without fixing the tests

item_template.title: [QA] Review one automated test
item_template.description: A branch in this repository adds one automated test. Review it.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given the test, when the suite runs, then it asserts the behaviour it names.

notes: A reviewer that rewrites a weak test has approved its own assertion, and the Automation Engineer ships the same weak test next time.
